task_completion.description: Navigate to the Currency settings section of the CRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Currencies' management page or settings menu open in the CRM interface.

task_completion.description: Add 'Euro' (EUR) to the list of currencies.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog or form showing 'Euro' or 'EUR' being selected or added to the currency list.

task_completion.description: Set the conversion rate for EUR to 0.92 and ensure it is active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The value '0.92' entered in the conversion rate field for EUR and the status set to 'Active' (checkbox or dropdown).

task_completion.description: Add 'Great Britain, Pounds' (GBP) to the list of currencies.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog or form showing 'Great Britain, Pounds' or 'GBP' being selected or added to the currency list.

task_completion.description: Set the conversion rate for GBP to 0.79 and ensure it is active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The value '0.79' entered in the conversion rate field for GBP and the status set to 'Active' (checkbox or dropdown).

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM graphical user interface to add currencies.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on buttons like 'Add New' or 'Save', and text entry within the browser, rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The agent did not use SQL or backend scripts to inject the currencies.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent does not open a terminal to run 'mysql' or 'psql' commands to modify the 'vtiger_currency_info' table directly.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the settings menu rather than jumping to a direct URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking through 'Settings' or 'Configuration' menus to reach the Currency section.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must add two specific currencies: Euro (EUR) with a conversion rate of exactly 0.92, and Great Britain, Pounds (GBP) with a conversion rate of exactly 0.79. Both must be set to 'Active' status. A tolerance of 0.005 is acceptable for the rates, but the agent should ideally input the exact values specified.
